basic_profile.bio: I am a 34-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas. I love exploring the realms of human psychology and true crime, hence my frequent visits to subreddits like MindHunter. During the day, I work freelance, designing logos and marketing materials for small businesses. I enjoy spending my evenings delving into online discussions or reading about the latest in criminology and behavioral science. I am single and live with my two cats. My online activity usually peaks during late evenings as that's when my creative juices flow best.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in graphic design comes from a blend of formal education, having completed a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, and over a decade of hands-on experience. I've also developed a keen interest in psychology and criminology through self-study and participating in related online communities.
